scope: Evidence-copy assembly only; no adapter, consumer or native gate was rerun or changed by this correction.

initial_diff_check.diagnostic_record_type: transcription of the observed command result
initial_diff_check.command_control_error: A following shell command list proceeded to the successful staged preflight and intermediate local commit despite the failed diff check.

initial_copy_omission.cause: Repository ignore rules excluded copied .log files from ordinary git add.

correction.method: Normal descendant commit; retain intermediate history, explicitly stage the five ignored logs, and use a local attributes file naming only seven immutable captured outputs.
correction.attribute_precedent: The repository root .gitattributes already uses these attributes for hash-bound captured command output.
correction.verification_basis: Compare each staged original to both SOURCE_AND_DELIVERY.json SHA-256 and its original local file; require all files to be tracked. Run staged and full-delivery diff checks with the strictly scoped attributes.
correction.final_commit_reference: Read back from Git after the correction commit; intentionally not embedded in its own tree.
